departure_events.csv.row_unit: One frozen departure event; two events per SID.
departure_events.csv.sid: IBTrACS storm identifier; the independent statistical unit.
departure_events.csv.event_id: Frozen event identity; unchanged from the event source.

event_class.internal: Temporary departure followed by a later return to the defined near-peak state.
event_class.final: Last defined departure from the near-peak state in the observed record; not necessarily physical storm extinction.

departure_events.csv.first_LMI_UTC: First occurrence of lifetime maximum recorded intensity, UTC.
departure_events.csv.last_LMI_UTC: Last occurrence of lifetime maximum recorded intensity, UTC.
departure_events.csv.termination_UTC: End of the available study record, UTC; not an assumption of physical extinction.
departure_events.csv.lon: Departure longitude, degrees east using the saved source convention.
departure_events.csv.age_h: Time from the study-defined starting observation to departure, hours.
departure_events.csv.land_contact: Frozen flag for recorded land contact in the 24 h preceding departure. The ocean sensitivity requires 0 for both events; no future-ocean or survival restriction is imposed.
departure_events.csv.basin_genesis: Basin of genesis, distinct from the actual departure or return location.

departure_centres.csv.row_unit: One frozen SID/event/UTC centre request; missing coordinates remain missing.
departure_centres.csv.UTC: Actual request time in UTC, not normalized lifecycle progress.
departure_centres.csv.lag_h: Hours relative to the frozen departure anchor. The -30 and +30 h rows supply derivative halos around the -24 to +24 h analysis.
departure_centres.csv.lat: Latitude in degrees north; no trajectory extrapolation is added here.
departure_centres.csv.lon: Longitude in degrees east using the saved source convention.
departure_centres.csv.motion_u_ms: Saved eastward translation velocity, m s-1.
departure_centres.csv.motion_v_ms: Saved northward translation velocity, m s-1.
departure_centres.csv.actual_track_point: Whether the centre comes from an actual track observation.
departure_centres.csv.position_extrapolated: Whether the source position was flagged as extrapolated. This package does not create extrapolated positions.
